REPORT

Foreign Affair Section,
C. & S. Branch. Station / File No. Date October 15, 1942.

SUBJECT: Re Attached

Reference the attached communication dated
October 13th, 1942 received from the Communal Associa-
tion of Central European Jews, enquiries show that
religious services have up to now been held every
Friday evening and Saturday morning at the Eastern
Cinema, 144 Muirhead Road. The Association now informs
that in future such services will be held on the
premises of the Shanghai Jewish Youth Association School,
627 E. Yuhang Road. The removal of services is
prompted by economy measures.

FILE
16 OCT. 1942

(S.B.) REGISTRY
DATE 17/10/42

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
C. & S. Branch.

D.O. "D" Division.
Passed to you please.

SHANGHAI, October 13, 1942
416 TONGSHAN ROAD, HOUSE 22
TEL. 50192
T/1z.

To the
Shanghai Municipal Police
185 Foochow Rd. Room 207
Local

Dear Sirs ,

We beg to inform you that we will remove our divine
services regularly held every Friday evening and Saturday morning
at the Eastern Theatre, Lairhead Road, from there to the
S.J.Y.A. (Kadoorie) - School, 627 East Yuheng Rd.

The removal will take place in course of the next weeks.

We have the honour to remain, Dear Sirs,

Yours very respectfully
Communal Association of Central European Jews
(Juedische Gemeinde)
Department of Religious Affairs
Lutz Wachener
（印：JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE - COMMUNAL ASSOCIATION OF CENTRAL EUROPEAN JEWS - SHANGHAI）
A. Fun, Secretary.

Date 10 . 9 . 42

SUBJECT: Jewish New Year Services to be held at
"Thal's Diele", 315/14 Wayside Rd.

Reference the attached communication, received
from Mr.Salomon Thal, licensee of the "Thal's Diele"
at 315/14 Wayside Rd, enquiries elicited the following
information.

The premises leased by Mr.Thal contain a hall
which is occasionally used for theatrical performances.
The persons named in the attached letter approached
Mr.Thal in order to hire the hall for the purpose of
holding Jewish New Year services after they had failed
in obtaining permission to hold such services at the
"Tabarin"Night Club,1124 Broadway E.

As the services, to be held at "Thal's Diele"
are of a private nature, it is respectfully suggested
that, in accordance with Supt.Yamaguchi's remark on
the report re "Tabarin",dated Aug.24th,1942-Sp.Br.file
No.D 5422(O)-1, permission to hold services at "Thal's
Diele" be refused.

（批：P.a. to C.p.）
（批：Recommended not to be granted as it is a private nature）

上海公共租界警察

主题：拟在韦斯特路315/14号“Thal's Diele”举行犹太新年礼拜活动。

参照随附的从韦斯特路315/14号“Thal's Diele”持牌人 Salomon Thal 先生处收到的函件，经查询获得以下信息。

Thal 先生租赁的场所包含一个偶尔用于戏剧表演的大厅。附件信函中提及的人员在未能获得在百老汇东路1124号“Tabarin”夜总会举行此类礼拜活动的许可后，接洽了 Thal 先生，意图租用该大厅以举行犹太新年礼拜活动。

鉴于拟在“Thal's Diele”举行的礼拜活动具有私人性质，谨建议根据山口警司在1942年8月24日关于“Tabarin”的报告（特别科档案号 D 5422(O)-1）中的意见，拒绝在“Thal's Diele”举行礼拜活动的许可。

（批注：呈警务总监。）
（批注：建议不予批准，因其属私人性质）

Jewish New Year Services to be held at
"Thal's Diele", 315/14 Wayside Rd.

Reference the attached communication, received
from Mr.Salomon Thal, licensee of the "Thal's Diele"
at 315/14 Wayside Rd, enquiries elicited the following
information.

The premises leased by Mr.Thal contain a hall
which is occasionally used for theatrical performances.

Shanghai, 2 Sept. 1942.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY No. DS422(0)-1 8.9.42）

To the Commissioner of Police,
185 Foochow Road.

Ref. No.D.5422(0)1

Dear Sir,

Reference your letter of Aug. 31st by which I am informed that permission to hold Jewish orthodox services at the "International" 81 Chusan Road can not be granted, I take the liberty of asking you to kindly re-consider your attitude in the light of the following reasons.

1. There are no other premises of this size in Hongkew and many people will have no place to say their prayers.
2. In restaurant will not operate and will be closed for the duration of the holidays.
3. The services will be held by chief cantor Gold-field and there shall be no speeches of any kind.
4. Voluntary donations which may be made during the services will be turned over to charitable institutions.
5. Holidays services have been held of the "International" for the past three years and there has never been any cause for the Police to interfere.

I sincerely hope that you will give this matter your kind attention and shall be much obliged to you for an early reply.

Yours very obediently

（印：S.M.P. REGISTRY DATE 8/9/42）
Cantor B. Goldfield

With reference to the attached communication received from Mr. S. Fuchs, German Jew, proprietor of the "International Restaurant", located at 81 Chusan Road, requesting permission to hold religious services, enquiries revealed the following information:-

The proposed religious services at the "International Restaurant" which it is proposed to hold on the dates and times mentioned in the attached letter, are in accordance with Jewish religious customs on the occasion of the Jewish Great Holidays - the New Year and the Day of Atonement.

The divine services are to commence on Sept. 11th, 1942, when cantor B. Goldfield, Russian Jew, will deliver sermons and prayers in the Hebrew language.

The seating capacity of the restaurant is for about 100 persons and in order to defray the cost of the lease of the premises cantor Goldfield intends to charge admission, the prices having been set at $2.00, $3.00 and $5.00.

SUBJECT: Jewish New Year Services to be held at the "Tabarin", 1124 Broadway East.

Reference the attached communication received from Mr. Wolf, the licencee of the bar-restaurant "Tabarin" at 1124 Broadway East, enquiries have elicited the following information:-

The premises in question have been rented from Mr. Wolf by an opera singer, Mr. Nicolai Schwarz, German Jew, 19/12 Wayside Road for the following times and dates:-

Sept. 11th. 6 p.m. - 7 p.m.
12th 9 a.m. - 12 noon
12th 6.15 p.m. - 7.15 p.m.
13th 9 a.m. - 12 noon
20th 6.15 p.m. - 8 p.m.
21st 9 a.m. - 7 p.m.

for the purpose of holding religious services during the Jewish New Year holidays and the "Day of Atonement". According to a plan produced by Mr. Schwarz 195 seats will be available at prices from $5.00 to $20.00.

Enquiries conducted at the "Jewish Community" show that the above mentioned services are in no way related to the services instituted by the "Jewish Community". It is obvious that the "Tabarin" services are due to private initiative, out for individual profit. It is learnt that Mr. Schwarz expects to clear $1,000.00 for himself which is a rather questionable attitude with regard to religious matters. SUBJECT: Jewish New Year Services to be held at the
Allgemeine Juedische Kueche (Public Jewish
Kitchen) at 1107/43 Broadway East

In the morning of August 24th, 1942, Mr.
Schey David, German Jew, attended this office in
order to inform that during the Jewish New Year
holidays divine services will be held at the Public
Jewish Kitchen, 1107/43 Broadway East, which premises
also serve as a synagogue. The person responsible
for the Kitchen as well as the services is Rabbi
Margulies, Polish Jew, residing at the same premises.
The Kitchen is a benevolent institution which
exists through voluntary contributions and provides
daily meals, prepared in the "Kosher" (according to
religious rites) way, to approximately 300 indigent
Jewish refugees.
Services will be held at the following times
and dates:-
Sept. 11th. 7 - p.m. to 7.30 p.m.
12th. 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.
8. p.m. to 8.30 p.m.
13th. 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.
20th 7 p.m. to 9 p.m.
21st. 8p.m. to 7.30 p.m.

Sitting accomodation has been provided for
130 persons. The money derived from the sale of
tickets - prices at the discretion of the buyer -
goes to the funds of the Kitchen.
The institution having a bona fide character
there appears to be no objection to the holding of
the services.

SUBJECT: New Year Services to be held by the
"Jewish Community."

Enquiries conducted with reference to the
contents of the attached letter reveal the following
particulars:-

In the evening of Sept. 11th, 1942 the Jewish .
New Year (5703) is due to begin. In accordance with
Jewish religious customs the advent of a new year is
celebrated for 2 days. These two days as well as the
"Day of Atonement," due ten days after New Year, form
the most important holidays of the Jewish religion. On
these 3 days the majority of Jews visit places of worship
in order to say their prayers.

In order to give local Central European Jews an
opportunity to attend services, the Communal Association
of Central European Jews, 416/22 Tongshan Road, (formerly
known as the "Jewish Community") has leased several
premises for times and dates as specified on the attached
letter. The same services were held during the New Year
festival in 1940 and 1941 and visits paid to them by
members of Special Branch showed that they were conducted
on strictly religious lines and did not give any cause
for objections.

In order to cover the expenses, incurred by the
"Jewish Community" for the renting of premises, employment
of precentors, choirs, etc. tickets for the services are
sold at prices ranging from $3.00 to $20.00 per seat for
services at the Eastern Theatre, 144 Muirhead Road, the
Broadway Cinema, 51 Wayside Road, the Shanghai Jewish
Youth Association School at 627 East Yuhang Road, and

主题：“犹太社区”拟举行的新年礼拜活动。

就附信内容进行的查询揭示了以下详情：-

1942年9月11日晚，犹太新年（5703年）即将开始。根据犹太宗教习俗，新年的庆祝活动持续两天。这两天以及新年后第十天的“赎罪日”，构成了犹太教最重要的节日。在这三天里，大多数犹太人都会前往礼拜场所祈祷。

为了让本地中欧犹太人有机会参加礼拜活动，位于同山路416/22号的中欧犹太人社区协会（前称“犹太社区”）已租赁了若干场地，具体时间和日期详见附信。在1940年和1941年的新年节日期间也举行过同样的礼拜活动，特别处成员曾前往视察，结果显示这些活动严格遵循宗教规范进行，未引起任何异议。

为了弥补“犹太社区”因租赁场地、雇佣领唱者、合唱团等而产生的费用，礼拜活动的门票将以每座3.00元至20.00元不等的价格出售，地点包括缪尔黑德路144号的东方大戏院、韦思德路51号的百老汇电影院、东余杭路627号的上海犹太青年会学校，以及

Die Beiträge für die Zwangsmitgliedschaft bei der Jüdischen
Gemeinde sind nunmehr mit Wirkung ab 1. April 1942 festgesetzt und
berechnen sich nach monatlichem Einkommen oder, falls der Ver-
brauch das Einkommen übersteigt, nach dem Verbrauch nach folgender
Skala:
Klasse I bis CN¥ 249.- ohne Beitrag
" II von CN¥ 250.- " " 749.- 2%
" III " " 750.- " " 1249.- 3%
" IV " " 1250.- " " 2499.- 3 1/2%
" V " " 2500.- " " 3999.- 4%
" VI " " 4000.- an und darüber 5%

In Klasse II und III sind abzugsberechtigt für die Ehefrau
10%, für jedes Kind unter 18 Jahren 5%, sowie für im gleichen
Haushalt lebende unterstützte Verwandte je 5% vom Monatsbeitrag.
Diese Sätze sind den Behörden vorgelegt und genehmigt worden.

wird durch diese Selbsteinschätzung der Mitglieder ersetzt.

verpflichtet, auch wenn Klasse I in Frage kommt.

SUBJECT: "ECOC" - Economical Co-operative Organization of Jewish Craftsmen in the Building Trade - (Erwerbs- und Wirtschaftsgenossenschaft der juedischen -Bauhandwerker in Shanghai) - Application for registration with the Municipal Police.

（批：Major Hole 13. 2. 42）
（批：se 5/2/144 D.F.）

Forwarded herewith is the application form for registration with the Municipal Police as received from an organization known as "ECOC" - Economical Co-operative Organization of Jewish Craftsmen in the Building Trade. This organization has been sponsored by one Josef KNOLLER, Austrian Jewish refugee for the purpose of securing work for its members who comprise builders, painters, electricians, carpenters, plumbers, masons, etc., etc. There are at present some thirty members while twenty more persons or so are expected to enrol themselves later on. Subscriptions of $1 or $2 per month will be collected from members who will also have to pay to the organization 5% of any proceeds secured from contracts.

Though this organization, according to KNOLLER, is not connected with the Juedische Gemeinde, all its members have to be adherents of the Juedische Gemeinde.

By means of advertising, personal visits and soliciting the organization will endeavour to secure work for its members in the building trade and its many subsidiary trades. In this connection your attention is drawn to a report dated June 4, 1941 (attached and flagged). Most of the members are at present unemployed and as the regulations are

兹转呈名为“ECOC” - 犹太建筑工匠经济合作社的组织提交的向工部局警务处注册的申请表。该组织由奥地利犹太难民 Josef KNOLLER 发起，旨在为其成员（包括建筑工、油漆工、电工、木匠、水管工、泥瓦匠等）谋取工作。目前约有三十名成员，预计后续将有约二十人加入。每月向成员收取1或2美元会费，成员还需将其从合同中获得的收益的5%支付给该组织。

尽管据 KNOLLER 称，该组织与 Juedische Gemeinde 无关，但其所有成员必须是 Juedische Gemeinde 的 adherents（追随者/成员）。

该组织将通过广告、个人拜访和招揽等方式，努力为其成员在建筑行业及其众多附属行业中谋取工作。在此方面，提请注意一份日期为1941年6月4日的报告（附后并标记）。大多数成员目前失业，且由于规定是

at present constituted KNOLLER has the controlling
interest in the organization and will decide who
will undertake the contracts, the amount of pay they
will receive, who carries out the various jobs, etc.,
etc. He seems to have put in a great deal of

and this seems to be the point at stake, this
organization is not an organization in the strict

business enterprise whose aims and objects are
merely bound up with the task of finding work for
its members, who will be responsible for carrying
out such work and thereby earning their livelihood.
In such circumstances, therefore,
it is respectfully suggested that registration is
unnecessary.
Nothing is known to the detriment

SUBJECT: JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE - Newly formed Board
of Directors - Communication dated July
28, 1941

（批：N. / 5/6/44 / 6.I）

The contents of the attached communication
from the local Juedische Gemeinde have been noted
with interest. Actually the Juedische Gemeinde
as an organization is nothing more nor less than a
joke in local refugee circles. It does not co-
operate with other refugee organizations in
Shanghai and in the past has bent its efforts
in fruitless attempts to cause dissension among
these other organizations.

（批：86. (CPSB) I）

（框内文字：
Commr. of Police.
Sir:
Information
（签名：Harman）
A. C. (S. R.)
）

The real functions of the Juedische Gemeinde
are closely bound with matters affecting religion
and culture but the Directors, who do not inspire
confidence in any shape or form, endeavour to
dabble in everything ranging from politics to
administrative capacities where the refugees are
concerned. They try to do this and that but
never manifest any desire to conduct any constructive
work for the refugees as a whole.

The names of the individuals comprising the
new Board of Directors have been noted by this
office which, through previous contact with certain
of them, does not form a very high opinion of their
abilities or standing among the refugees.

A.C. (Special Branch).

（签名：Ja. Puto）
D/S.I.

（印：RECEIVED BY / CENTRAL REGISTRY / DATE 6 8 41）

by Josef KNOLLER.

Copies sent
D.D.
O/C Wayuè

With reference to the contents of
the attached communication the meeting in question
has been postponed until 8 p. m. June 10, 1941.
Josef KNOLLER, chairman of the "Craftmen's Section"
of the Juedische Gemeinde, has been interviewed
in respect of his application and the following
information gathered:-

KNOLLER, Austrian Jewish refugee,
unemployed master house-painter, residing at
705 Tongshan Road, has, from his own knowledge of
local economic conditions, prepared a treatise on
matters affecting employment, scales of pay, etc.,
etc. in relation to the work of house-painters,
interior-decorators and other persons engaged in
renovating or building houses and apartments.
This treatise, which will form the basis for his
lecture at the Shanghai Jewish Youth Association
School, has been examined and in a few words its
object is to show some 130 decorators who will
comprise the audience on June 10 why they should
form some kind of association whereby they can
secure employment and undercut prices charged by
contractors (non-Jewish) working for concerns such
as Arts & Crafts, Shanghai Land Investment Co.,
Cathay Land Co., etc., etc.

There would appear to be nothing
objectionable in the proposed lecture which will
not be permitted to become a public discussion.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / JUN 4 1941 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

Juedische Gemeinde “工匠部”主席
Josef KNOLLER 就其申请接受了问询，
收集到的信息如下：-

KNOLLER，奥地利犹太难民，
失业的资深房屋油漆工，居住于
同山路705号，根据其对
当地经济状况的了解，撰写了一篇关于
影响房屋油漆工、室内装饰工及其他从事
房屋和公寓翻新或建造人员就业、工资标准等
事项的论文。
该论文将作为其在上海犹太青年协会
学校演讲的基础，经审查，简而言之，其目的
是向6月10日将由约130名装饰工组成的听众说明，
他们为何应组建某种协会，以便获得就业机会，
并以低于为非犹太人公司（如 Arts & Crafts、上海地产投资公司、
国泰地产公司等）工作的承包商的价格承接业务。

拟议的演讲似乎没有任何
不妥之处，且不允许演变为公开讨论。

September 4, 1940. B. D. SH 22 (e)
4 9 40
Deputy Commissioner, (Special Branch).

Sir,

The Juedische Gemeinde first came to the notice of the Shanghai Municipal Police in May 1939 when a letter was received asking for Police permission to hold a religious service in the Broadway Theatre on May 25th in connection with the second day of Pentecost (Shabuoth). Enquiries were made by the Special Branch and a copy of the report was sent to the Divisional Officer, "D" Division.

In August 1939 a further letter was received from the management of the Broadway Theatre stating that they had agreed to allow the Juedische Gemeinde, then known as the Juedische Kultusgemeinde, to use their premises for the purpose of holding five religious services during September 1939. Further letters were received stating that in addition to the above, two additional services would be held that month.

Enquiries were made by the Special Branch and a copy of the report was forwarded to the Divisional Officer, "D" Division.
（批：2/ 3/6/40 A.T.）

On November 28th 1939, a similar request was received and as a result of enquiries made by the Special Branch it was ascertained that the Kultusgemeinde (Religious Parish Society) had changed its title to that of the Juedische Gemeinde (Jewish Community). A copy of this report was also passed to the Divisional Officer, "D" Division, and Officer i/c Wayside Station.

A further application was received on March 1, 1940 for permission to hold a religious festive hour at the Shanghai Jewish School, 500 Seymour Road, on March 3rd, 1940. Information regarding this was passed to Divisional Officer, "B" Division, and Officer i/c Bubbling Well Station.

（左侧手写批注）：
E.P.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 5 SEPT. 1940）
Information.
Mr. Speelman's recognition of the "Juedisch Gemeinde" is a mere formality for as detailed in this report, the Association has functioned since May of last year.
The Asscn. needs strict supervision or it will rapidly develop into a political organization.
D.O. "D" & Insp. i/c. Wayside Stn., in my last conversations with them agreed with this view.

（底部签名及批注）：
R.R. Yorke.
Sent, 4/9.

On May 21st 1940, an application was received from
the Brit Trumpeldor, new Zionist organization, for permission
to hold a meeting at the International Restaurant, 81 Chusan
Road. As a result of enquiries made by the Special Branch,
it was ascertained that the meeting was in connection with
the forthcoming election of the committee of the Juedische
Gemeinde, its purpose being to protest against the procedure
followed in electing the committee. This application was
refused by the Commissioner of Police as it was contrary to
condition 5 of the restaurant licence. Observation was
kept by members of the Special Branch and staff of Wayside
Station but no attempt was made to proceed with the meeting.

On May 21st 1940, an application was received for
permission to hold religious services at the Broadway Theatre
on June 12th and 13th. Enquiries were made by the Special
Branch and copies of the report were sent to the Divisional
Officer, "D" Division, and Officer i/c Wayside Station. In
view of the contents of Special Branch report dated May 22nd
arrangements were made for a close watch to be kept on this
and subsequent meetings. As the services were held in
German and Hebrew it was necessary for officers conversant
follow
with these languages to be present in order to closely^the
proceedings in order that no politics were discussed during
the services.

These precautions have been continued at several
subsequent religious meetings held by the Juedische Gemeinde
and Theodor Herzl Societies which were held on July 28th
1940, August 17th, 24th, 31st and September 1st, 1940.
Nothing objectionable from a police point of view has been
noticed at any of these meetings.

REPORT
Date September 29. 1940

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. S.RY B. D. 3422(2)）

Subject. JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE - Communal Association of Central European Jews.

Made by. D.S.I. Pitts Forwarded by. D.S.I. Logan 29/6/44 S.I.

With reference to the contents of
letter dated August 20, 1940 from Mr. M. SPEELMAN
to the Shanghai Municipal Council and the reply
thereto in which mention is made of the recognition
of the Juedische Gemeinde by the Committee for the
Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai,
there would appear to be no objection from a Police
point of view to the former organization functioning
in Shanghai providing it confines itself solely to
matters regarding religion and the registration of
births, deaths and marriages in the refugee community.

In the past it has been observed by
this office that the organization in question has
lent itself to semi-political activities. Continued
warnings from Headquarters, however, have had the
effect of curbing such activities and it is a fact
that at present it concerns itself only with religious
and communal affairs.

Certain members of the committee are
persons of doubtful standing in Shanghai while the
majority of Jewish refugees speak disparagingly of
the organization as a whole. A close watch,
however, is maintained over the activities of the
organization and should at any time Police interference
be deemed desirable, your attention will be immediately
drawn to the facts of the case.

D.C. (Special Branch).
（签名：Ja. Pitts.）
D.S.I.

（左下角手写：4/3/19）

制作人：特务督察 Pitts 转呈人：特务督察 Logan 1944年6月29日 S.I.

鉴于 M. SPEELMAN 先生于1940年8月20日致上海公共租界工部局的信函内容，以及对此信的回复（其中提及上海援助欧洲犹太难民委员会对 Juedische Gemeinde 的认可），从警务角度来看，只要该组织将其活动严格局限于宗教事务以及难民社区内的出生、死亡和婚姻登记，其在上海运作似乎并无不妥。

本处过去曾观察到，该组织曾卷入半政治性活动。然而，总部的持续警告已起到遏制此类活动的作用，事实是，目前该组织仅关注宗教和社区事务。

该委员会的某些成员在上海的地位令人存疑，而大多数犹太难民对该组织整体评价不佳。不过，警方对该组织的活动保持着严密监视，若任何时候认为警方干预是可取的，将立即提请阁下注意相关事实。

副总监（特务科）。

With reference to the attached communication
dated August 10, 1940, received from the management of
the "Broadway Theatre", 57 Wayside Road, regarding the
proposed religious services to be held at the above
theatre, on August 17, 24 and 31, 1940, and on September
1, 1940, enquiries ascertained the following:- the
"Judische Gemeinde" (Jewish Community) is identical with
the "Kultusgemeinde" (Religious Parish Society) and is
a branch of the Committee for the Assistance of European
Jewish refugees in Shanghai. The society, located at
House 5, Lane 805, East Seward Road, is headed by Mr.L.
Steinhardt, German-Jew, with Mr.Albert Trum, German-Jew,
acting as the Secretary-General.

According to Mr.A.Trum, the proposed religious
services on August 17, 24 and 31, 1940, are to be held
in observance of the usual Jewish "Sabbath Day". The
services, with an expected attendance of approximately
200 people, are to commence at 9 a.m. and are expected
to terminate at about 11 a.m. On Sunday, September 1,
1940, between the hours of 9.30 a.m. and 11.30 a.m., an
additional religious sermon with an assistance of a choir
will be given as a prelude to the forthcoming religious
festivals namely the "Rosch Haschana" and "Jom Kippur"
to be held during October, 1940, On the latter mentioned
religious sermon an attendance of about 500 people is
expected.

Mr.A.Trum states that nothing of political
nature will take place during the religious services.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（签名：S. Mischenko. D. S.）

关于所附1940年8月10日来自韦思德路57号“百老汇剧院”管理处的函件，该函涉及拟于1940年8月17日、24日、31日及9月1日在上述剧院举行的宗教仪式，经查询查明如下：“Judische Gemeinde”（犹太社区）与“Kultusgemeinde”（宗教教区协会）系同一组织，且为上海援助欧洲犹太难民委员会的一个分支。该社团位于西华德路805弄5号，由德籍犹太人 L. Steinhardt 先生领导，德籍犹太人 Albert Trum 先生担任秘书长。

据 A. Trum 先生称，拟于1940年8月17日、24日和31日举行的宗教仪式是为了遵守常规的犹太“安息日”。预计参加人数约为200人，仪式将于上午9时开始，预计于上午11时左右结束。1940年9月1日星期日，上午9:30至11:30之间，将举行额外的宗教布道，并有唱诗班协助，作为即将于1940年10月举行的“Rosch Haschana”（新年）和“Jom Kippur”（赎罪日）宗教节日的前奏。预计参加后一场宗教布道的人数约为500人。

A. Trum 先生表示，宗教仪式期间不会发生任何具有政治性质的活动。

Subject. JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE - Posters in the German language attacking
this organization.
Made by. D.S.I. Pitts. Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached poster in the
German language forwarded to the Special Branch from
Wayside Station, enquiries reveal that the person
responsible for having this poster - a number of
which were distributed and/or stuck on walls in
the Wayside District on July 1 - printed was one
Max NACHT, German Jewish refugee, residing in the
Wayside Home, I.C. Card 2062. He had these
posters printed at the Centurion Press, 61 Yangtszepoo
Road.
to
He has been called to this office and warned
that his action is a breach of the Proclamation
of the Shanghai Municipal Council dated August 17,
1937 and entitled "Emergency Measures." He has
been informed that a repetition of his offence will
result in his being punished severely.

NACHT is an ordinary member of the JUEDISCHE
GEMEINDE and he states that many of the 1500 members
are dissatisfied with the manner in which this
organization has recently conducted the election
of its praesidium. The election, he avers, was
not carried out in a constitutional fashion and a
number of adherents are completely displeased about
the way in which the affairs of the organization
are being handled.

Enquiries from other sources reveal, however,
another state of affairs. Primarily the Organization
was inaugurated to look after religious affairs.

关于韦思德分署转交特务科的所附德文海报，经查询，负责印制该海报（其中多份于7月1日在韦思德区分发和/或张贴于墙壁上）的人是一名名为 Max NACHT 的德籍犹太难民，居住在韦思德收容所，身份证号码 2062。他在杨树浦路61号 Centurion Press 印制了这些海报。

此人已被传唤至本办公室，并受到警告，其行为违反了上海公共租界工部局于1937年8月17日发布、题为“紧急措施”的公告。已告知他，若再犯此类罪行，将受到严厉惩罚。

然而，来自其他方面的查询揭示了另一种情况。首先，该组织的成立旨在处理宗教事务。

A number of religious ceremonies have been held
which have been attended by large crowds of Jewish
refugees. The services have been conducted in
the orthodox manner in the Hebrew language with a
male choir and without organ music. Certain members
of the Organization have been clamouring that the
German language be used in these services, that the
choir be composed of men and women and that organ
music be utilized. Whatever the true reason for the
break that has manifested itself in the ranks of
the Juedische Gemeinde - and it seems certain that
the election and religious questions form the
main reason - there is no reason at all for these
posters to be stuck up and general annoyance
caused to the authorities.
The Juedische Gemeinde is, in the main,
composed of men whose characters will not bear
strict investigation. It is not recognized by
either the Komor or Kann sponsored groups and its
value to the local refugee community seems rather
doubtful. Ever since it came into existence in
May 1939 it has been a source of continual trouble
to the Police and though it is not registered with
the Police, it is respectfully suggested that steps
be taken to suppress it entirely, since the
bickering and quarrelling that appear to be
associated with its name occupy the time of the
Police and public out of all proportion to the
usefulness it renders.

已举行多次宗教仪式，大量犹太难民出席参加。这些礼拜活动均按正统方式以希伯来语进行，配有男声合唱团，且无管风琴音乐伴奏。该组织的某些成员一直强烈要求在这些礼拜活动中使用德语，合唱团由男女混合组成，并使用管风琴音乐伴奏。无论犹太社区（Juedische Gemeinde）内部出现分裂的真正原因是什么——看来选举和宗教问题似乎是主要原因——完全没有理由张贴这些海报，给当局造成普遍的困扰。

犹太社区（Juedische Gemeinde）主要由一些经不起严格审查其品行的人员组成。它既未得到科莫尔（Komor）派系的支持，也未得到坎恩（Kann）派系的支持，其对当地难民群体的价值似乎相当可疑。自1939年5月成立以来，它一直是警方的麻烦源头，尽管它未在警方注册，但谨建议采取步骤将其彻底取缔，因为与其名称相关的争吵和纠纷所消耗的警方时间和公众精力，与其所提供的效用完全不成比例。

Although it has for its aims the pursuance
of cultural and relgious affairs, there is little
doubt that the Juedische Gemeinde indulges in
semi-political activities.

The Honorary President is now Mr. R. D.
ABRAHAM, Arabian Jew of long standing in Shanghai,
who is well-known for his pro-Zionist inclinations.
It seems that with this gentleman in the position
he now occupies, the Juedische Gemeinde feel that
they are in a stronger position than hitherto, but
it is believed that a service would be done to the
entire community if the organization was completely
suppressed and not permitted to function further.

Translation of a poster in German reported to have been taken
off the wall outside Lane 805/5 East Seward Road on 1-7-40.

The PRESIDIUM OF THE JEWISH COMMUNITY has resigned!
We should have been notified of this in the newspapers!
Instead of this we learn that the "Presidium" under the chair-
manship of Dr. Lesser h..s secretly undertaken the "COOPTATION"
of eleven more members of the Presidium!
SUCH IS THE MANNER IN WHICH THE " PRESIDIUM " HAS CAR-
RIED OUT ITS OWN REGULATIONS REGARDING THE ELECTIONS!
We bring against the members of the old "Presidium" of
the Jewish Community the charge of incapability,we demand that
the Presidium be elected in accordance with truly free and de-
mocratic foundations. The Presidium of the Jewish Community
must resign! It does not enjoy the confidence of members!
The "coopted" members of the Presidium are hereby in-
vited to express the distrust of members of the community to
members of the old"Presidium" and to compel them to resign.

THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IS NECESSARY.
THE PRESENT PRESIDIUM MUST DISAPPEAR!

The Committee for the carrying out of elections
of the Presidium of the Jewish Community.

据报于1940年7月1日从西华德路（East Seward Road）805弄5号外墙上撕下的德文海报译文。

犹太社区主席团已辞职！
我们本应在报纸上获知此事！
然而，我们却得知，在Lesser博士主持下的“主席团”秘密“增补”了十一名主席团成员！
这就是“主席团”执行其自身关于选举的规定的方式！
我们要指控犹太社区旧“主席团”成员无能，我们要求按照真正自由和民主的基础选举主席团。犹太社区主席团必须辞职！它并未获得成员的信任！
现邀请被“增补”的主席团成员向旧“主席团”成员表达社区成员的不信任，并迫使他们辞职。

犹太社区是必要的。
现任主席团必须消失！

犹太社区主席团选举执行委员会。

SUCH IS THE MANNER IN WHICH THE " PRESIDIUM " HAS CAR-

We bring against the members of the old "Presidium" of
the Jewish Community the charge of incapability, we demand that

members of the old "Presidium" and to compel them to resign.

Date May 31. 1940.

Subject "Juedische Gemeinde" - Proposed Religious Meeting to be held
at the Broadway Theatre.
Made by. D.P.S. Danemanis Forwarded by Supt. Mason.

The "Juedische Gemeinde" at 805/5 East Seward
Road, is a religious organization claiming approximately
1,600 followers. This organization is headed by one
named Leopold Steinhardt, German Jew, residing at 805/5
East Seward Road, who is the writer of the attached
communication. The "Juedische Gemeinde" forms the
subject of Sp.Br.File No. D. 5422(0), according to
which this organization has been used by the Japanese
Resident's Corporation in obtaining votes for Japanese
candidates during the S.M.C. elections of April 10th
and 11th 1940. Mr. Steinhardt was interviewed by
D.I. Crawford on the 23-5-40 and subsequently on the
23-5-40, when he was warned that no meetings of a
political or quasi-political nature will be permitted
by the police.

With regard to the proposed service at 7 a.m.
on the 12th and 13th of June 1940, in the "Broadway
Theatre", this function will be open to the general
public, free of charge, and is being held in recogni-
tion of the annual "Shevous" holiday (Whitsuntide).
The audience, which is expected to be about 600 strong
will be addressed by Rabbi Dr. J.Zeitin and Rabbi K.H.
Sober, who will deliver a lecture on the historical
and religious significance of this holiday. The
religious service will be conducted in the German and
Hebrew languages, and will be of a purely religious
nature.

位于西华德路805弄5号的“Juedische Gemeinde”是一个声称拥有约1,600名追随者的宗教组织。该组织由一名名为Leopold Steinhardt的德国犹太人领导，他居住在西华德路805弄5号，也是随函所附信件的作者。“Juedische Gemeinde”是特别处档案第 D. 5422(0) 号的主题，根据该档案，该组织曾在1940年4月10日和11日的工部局选举中被日本居留民团利用，为日本候选人获取选票。Steinhardt先生曾于1940年5月23日接受侦探督察 (D.I.) Crawford的问询，随后在同一天，他被警告警方不允许举行任何具有政治或准政治性质的集会。

80.D'
wayside.

With reference to the attached communication
received from Mr. Albert Trum, secretary-general of the
"Jewish Community of Central European Jews", located at
Lane 50 House 28, Ward Road, I beg to state, that the
"Juedische Gemeinde" (Jewish Community) is identical with
the "Kultusgemeinde" (Religious parish society), the
name of the latter having been changed, about a month
ago, to "Juedische Gemeinde", which is a branch of the
Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish refugees
in Shanghai.

The proposed religious service will be held, for
the convenience of Jewish emigrants, in the "Broadway
Theatre", 57 Wayside Road, from 9 a.m. till 12 noon, on
the 3-12-39, when an attendance of approximately 500-600
persons is expected.

According to Mr. A.Trum, who was interviewed on
the 30-11-39 p.m., nothing of a political nature will
take place during the service.

D.S.I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

A Jewish Religious festive hour is to be held in the
Broadway-Theatre on Sunday, December 3rd, 1939 from 9 a.m. till
about 12 noon. The programme will contain Jewish Songs performed
by a choir, an orchestra and soloists, and two festive speeches
given by Mr. Rudolf Glaser and Mr. Hugo Kaufmann or Mr. Leopold
Steinhardt. Admission to the above is gratis and free of charge.

In accordance with police regulations there will be no
speech, discussion or anything of a political nature, taking place
during this gathering,

Yours obediently,
JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE
Jewish Community of Central European Jews.
Albert Trum
Secretary-General.

Subject Central European Jews - Religious Service To Be Held in Broadway
Cinema, Wayside.
Made by. D.E. Mischenko Forwarded by. D.I.I. O Wittlin
With reference to the attached communication
received from the Committee for the Assistance of
European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai, Mr. I. Steinhardt,
the managing director of the Kultusgemeinde, located at
No.28, Lane 50, Ward Road, was interviewed and the
following particulars were obtained: Kultusgemeinde
(Religious parish society) is the branch of the Committee
for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in
Shanghai. The proposed religious services at the
Broadway Theatre on the dates and the times mentioned
will be held on the occasion of the Jewish Great
Holidays (New Year and the Day of Atonement).
Prior to the Jewish Great Holidays which
commence from September 13, 1939, a religious festive
hour will take place in the Broadway Theatre, at 10.30
a.m. on August 27, 1939. This religious festive hour
will be conducted strictly in accordance with the pro-
gramme herewith attached.
Mr. I. Steinhardt stated that the Broadway
Theatre was leased for the days specified in the attached
letter to the Police, for the sum of $550.00.
In order to cover the expenses for the lease of
the Broadway Theatre, a chorus and advertising expenses,
it was decided by the Committee to charge an entrance
fee from $1.00 to $5.00 according to sitting accommodation.
Tickets are obtainable at the offices of the Kultusgemeinde
Committee and in places advertised in the attached pro-
gramme. No entrance fee will be charged for the
religious festive hour on August 27, 1939. An attendance

在始于1939年9月13日的犹太重大节日之前，将于1939年8月27日上午10时30分在百老汇大戏院举行一次宗教节庆活动。此次宗教节庆活动将严格按照随附的程序进行。

I. Steinhardt 先生表示，百老汇大戏院已按致警方附件信函中指定的日期租用，租金为550.00美元。

Enquiries conducted with reference to the 
contents of the attached letter reveal the following 
particularst- 

In the evening of Sept. llth, 1942 the Jewish - 
New Year (5703) is due to begin. In accordance with 
Jewish religious customs the advent of a new year is 
celebrated for 2 days. These two days as well as the 
"Day of Atonement," due ten days after New Year, form 
the most important holidays of the Jewish religion. On 
these 3 days the majority of Jews visit places of worship 
in order to say their prayers. 

In order to give local Central European Jews an 
Opportunity to attend services, the Communal Association 
of Central European Jews, 416/22 Tongshan Road, (formerly 
known as the "Jewish Community") has leased several 
premises for times and dates as specified on the attached 
letter. The same services were held during the New Year 
festival in 1940 and 1941 and visits paid to them by 
members of Special Branch showed that they were conducted 
on strictly religious lines and did not giye any cause 
for objections. ios 

In order to cover the expenses, incurred by the 
“Jewish Community” for the renting of premises, employment | 
of precentors, choirs, etc. tickets for the services are | 
sold at prices ranging from $3.00 to $20.00 per seat for 
services at the Eastern Theatre, 144 Muirhead Road, the 
Broadway Cinema, 51 Wayside Road, the Shanghai Jewish 
Youth Association School at 627 East Yuheng Road, and

condition 5 of the restaurant licence. Observation was 
kept by members of the Special Branch and staff of Wayside 
Station but no attempt was made to proceed with the meeting. 

On May 21st 1940, an application was received for

A number of religious ceremonies have been held

male choir and without organ music. Certain members 
of the Organization have been clamouring that the

choir be composed of men and women and that organ 
music be utilized. ‘whatever the true reason for the 
break that has manifested itself in the ranks of 

the Juedische Gemeinde - and it seems certain that 
the election and religious questions form the 

main reason = there is no reason at all for these 
posters to be stuck up and general annoyance 

caused to the authorities.

composed of men whose characters will not bear 
strict investigation. It is not recognized by 
either the Komor or Kann sponsored groups and its 
value to the local refugee community seems rather 
doubtful. Ever since it came into existence in 
May 1939 it has been a source of continual trouble 
to the Police and though it is not registered with 
the Folice, it is respectfully suggested that steps 
be taken to suppress it entirely, since the 
bickering and quarrelling that appear to be 
associated with its mame occupy the time of the 


Police and public out of all proportion to the 


usefulness it renders.
